description: Retrieve a code-shaped atomic blueprint of a VibeMap project — relationships hydrated, Kanban metadata stripped, with synthesized interactions and entity state machines. It covers the WHOLE project and can be very large on big projects (on the order of 150K tokens), so use it for one-off whole-project work such as an initial scaffold or an audit. While building a ticket, do not fetch it: call vibemap_get_criterion_context for the criterion you are working on instead, which returns only what that criterion needs, in a few thousand tokens. For general reading prefer vibemap_get_project_context.
name: vibemap_get_atomic_blueprint
